サッカーの「ダイナモ」はなぜ発電機なのか――The engine behind the team

Why do we call a hard-working footballer a dynamo? 発電機の語源、midfield roles、Soviet Dynamo clubs、そしてrunning statisticsの限界を、初心者向けに解きほぐす。The key question is not simply how far a player runs, but what that running makes possible for the team.
